currency.shopSettingsHelp: The currency your customers see your prices, cart and orders in. You keep entering your prices in CFA francs: conversion is automatic.
currency.conversionNote: Your prices are still entered in CFA francs. Your customers see them converted to {currency} (1 {currency} = {rate} CFA francs).
currency.usdRateMissing: The US dollar rate hasn't been set by the ManuShop team yet: until it is, your customers see your prices in CFA francs.
currency.referenceNotice: Amounts in CFA francs, the reference currency of your prices.

platformRates.title: Exchange rates
platformRates.description: Rates used to display the prices of shops that chose a currency other than the CFA franc. Prices are still stored in CFA francs.
platformRates.eurFixed: Euro: official fixed parity, €1 = {rate} CFA francs.
platformRates.usdLabel: 1 US dollar is worth (in CFA francs)
platformRates.usdHelp: The US dollar has no fixed parity with the CFA franc: update this rate regularly. Until a rate is saved, the indicative rate of 600 CFA francs applies.
platformRates.invalid: Enter a rate between 50 and 5,000 CFA francs.
platformRates.error: The rate couldn't be saved. Please try again.
platformRates.usdDefault: Rate in effect: $1 = {rate} CFA francs (default indicative rate, none saved yet).

cart.otherShopConfirm: Your cart contains items from another shop. An order can only involve one shop: empty the cart to add this item?

launchPromoSettings.title: Homepage promotion
launchPromoSettings.description: The offer shown with a countdown on the homepage. It disappears by itself on its end date.
launchPromoSettings.enabledHelp: When disabled, the promotion no longer appears on the homepage, even before its end date. Its texts stay saved for later.
launchPromoSettings.eyebrowHelp: Short text above the title, for example "Launch offer". Optional.
launchPromoSettings.titleHelp: The main sentence of the offer, in large type.
launchPromoSettings.descriptionHelp: What merchants gain by taking the offer, in one or two sentences.
launchPromoSettings.endsAtHelp: The countdown stops at this date and time, and the promotion disappears from the homepage.
launchPromoSettings.statusEnded: Ended: it is no longer shown on the homepage.
launchPromoSettings.statusDisabled: Disabled: it is not shown on the homepage.
launchPromoSettings.saved: Promotion saved: the homepage is up to date.
launchPromoSettings.error: The promotion couldn't be saved. Please try again.
